description.en: Inline ghost-text next-word prediction for the DeepSeek Harness composer: suggests your next words from the conversation and current draft (including the likely reply or chosen option when the assistant asks a question), shown as grey text at the end of the input; Tab accepts, Esc dismisses.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 输入框内联续写预测：根据对话上下文和当前草稿，用灰色幽灵字预测你接下来要打的字（含助手提问时对下一条回复/选项的预测），显示在输入框最后一个字符后面；Tab 采纳，Esc 忽略。
